scope: Independent review of local draft wallet recovery, autoplay, all74 presentation/media evidence durability and gated catalogue replacement. No production mutation.

findings.result: User stop invalidates autoplay generation during animation and between rounds; 14-check browser fixture includes no-extra-wager gap and restart regressions.
Unreadable or mismatched stored requests preserve raw bytes and block Spin, Gamble, Retry and submit until validated reconnect; exact-token replay remains supported.
Schema2 durable unverifiedPins retains previous hashes across interrupted runs even after local journal loss.
Attempt numbers include existing directories and supervisor finalization writes both current row and matching attempt row; active batch historical backfill owned by repo_state.
Generic changed text remains unverified until semantic review; Bet and Spin require observed value/receipt evidence.

133 prior batch JSON files had no query/fragment-bearing texture source/cache alias or control-background URL; new presentation captures strip URL credentials/query/fragment and opaque data/blob sources.
